tree.heading: Manufacturer
tree.text: The term “manufacturer” means any person engaged in the business of buying milk in commerce for the purpose of manufacturing dairy products.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Agriculture.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2002—Par. (1). Pub. L. 107–171 inserted hyphen after “means”, designated remainder of existing provisions as subpar. (A), substituted “; and” for period at end, and added subpar. (B).
